name: workflow-from-the-paper
componentIdentificationPrompt:
Classify into one of the following categories.

- Explore: Listing, navigating, and reading files to gather contextual information.
- Locate: Identifying specific code regions or elements relevant to the bug or issue.
- Search: Employing search tools to find occurrences of code elements, symbols, or patterns expressed via regular expressions.
- Reproduce: Creating test cases to confirm the presence of the bug or the issue.
- Generate fix: Proposing or writing code modifications intended to resolve the issue.
- Run tests: Executing test cases to validate the proposed fix or to validate the test cases themselves.
- Refactor: Improving code quality through optimization, reformatting, or commenting.
- Explain: Producing natural language explanations or summaries of the issue or applied fix.
